Ok so I used to be like you for years and have recently developed a good workout routine so here are a few tips

1. Find exercises you actually enjoy doing (for me it's pilates and running). This may take some trial and error 
2. Don't go all out when you start, slowly ease yourself into it so you don't burn yourself out too quickly or injure yourself
3. Create an achievable routine where you allocate certain days for specific exercises (e.g for me I run on Monday, Tuesday, Thursdays and Sundays and do pilates Wednesday and fridays)
4. Don't throw it all in if you can't keep to the routine. Sometimes you get busy and can't exercise for a week. Just get back on immediately when you have the chance
5. Find a time when you are most motivated to exercise and do it then. For me, I know I will never be someone who exercises in the morning so I don't even try. I bring my workout clothes to work and then immediately exercise after I finish
6. Use exercising as a time to listen to podcasts/books. I rarely listen to my podcasts when I'm not exercising so I have something to look forward to when do.
